chapter: Teddy Wilson, Cafe Society and bebop
title: Charlie Christian and Django Reinhardt
summary: He was astounded by Charlie Christian's guitar and found his feeling different from Django's.

story.theme_name: Banjo, guitar and the rhythm section: instruments and players
story.community_name: Banjo, guitar and the rhythm section's changing role

blocks.x: Uh-huh. Now what about, speaking of musicians who played differently, what about Charlie Christian when you first heard him?
Well he was -- he was -- I was so -- so astounded because I never heard a guitar played like that before.
It was marvelous thing to hear him play like that.
But you liked him right from the --
Well, I had heard Django Reinhardt, too, you know, before that.
Django was very impressive, also. But Charlie had more -- altogether different feeling. Of what he was doing, than Django.
